app.name: ScummVM (RPX test)
app.coder: ScummVM Team; Wii U port by Rrhapsod
app.short_description: SCUMM v7/v8, MM/Xeen and SCI/SCI32 test
app.long_description: Post-0.6.0 compatibility test, not a stable release. Adds engines for The Curse of Monkey Island, World of Xeen and Quest for Glory IV. I have not tested these games with this build on Wii U yet. Non-Aroma RPX operation remains unverified. Includes the same executable as the matching Aroma WUHB. Back up configuration and saves; extract the complete package including scummvm/data/mm.dat. See TESTING.md for installation, controls and test scenarios. Games and MT-32 ROMs are not included.
